entities.text: IInd Additional Session Judge, Ambah, District- Morena (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is the submission of counsel for appellant that the trial Court erred in convicting and awarding jail sentence to appellant.
Appellant suffered incarceration of 6 years and 8 months as pre and post-trial confinement and hearing of appeal shall take time.
It is further submitted that appellant and prosecutrix shared emotional and physical proximity by consent.
Learned counsel refers the statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and supplementary statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C. to bring home the analogy of consent.
It is further submitted that even in the Court statement, she admits 2 CRA-697-2020 that she used to converse with appellant on mobile phone.
It highly improbable that she lived with appellant around 20 days without raising any alarm.
She was at the cusp of attaining majority and according to counsel for the appellant, she was major.
Even, as per prosecution, she was more than 16 years of age.
Appellant does not bear any criminal record and he has already suffered sufficient period of custody.
He has good case on merits.
Hence, he prays that his case be considered for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and prays for dismissal of instant application for suspension of sentence.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.

Considering the rival submissions, especially the period of custody which is more than 6 years 8 months and the course of events as unfolded through the statement of prosecutrix and medical report belies the allegations, this Court, without commenting on the merits of the case, intends to allow the application for suspension of sentence (I.A.No.13710/2025).

7. Accordingly, I.A. No.13710/2025 stands allowed and it is directed that if appellant furnishes bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court that he shall appear before the Principal Registrar of this Court first on 15.07.2026 and thereafter, on all other subsequent dates as may be fixed by the Office for appearance in this regard, subject to deposit of fine amount, he shall be released on bail and 3 CRA-697-2020 execution of his jail sentence shall remain suspended till final disposal of this appeal.
8. Appellant shall not be the source of embarrassment and harassment to the complainant party/prosecutrix in any manner and shall not move in their vicinity.

Appellant shall not try to contact the prosecutrix either in person or through somebody else or through digital/electronic mode; otherwise, benefit of bail given today by way of suspension of sentence shall be withdrawn immediately.
9. I.A. No.13710/2025 stands allowed and disposed of, accordingly.
10. Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and necessary compliance.
11. Certified copy as per rules.
(ANAND PATHAK) (PUSHPENDRA  JUDGE JUDG
